scope: Fresh complete matches; same source-v2 control. Raw and robust change only qualified reform rankings. Parameter bootstrap is not outcome confidence; 5% deadband was fixed before these runs. No selection of a new threshold on validation.

metadata.rule: Ranking only, not win/claim gating. Robust needs training-bootstrap 5th percentile > 0 AND point-model relative gain >= 5%. The 5% deadband is engineering, not a return confidence interval.

delta.method: seed-cluster percentile bootstrap; equal weight per source seed
